features.quote: Workshops run from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM
features.rationale: The schedule states that workshops run during the afternoon, so dance classes are part of the event.
The description promises outstanding performances and shows by artists.
The event has three dance rooms: Salsa, Bachata and Kizomba.
